question: Who has been awarded the Global Indian Icon of the Year at the annual UK-India Awards in June, 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mary Kom**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Mary Kom was honoured with the Global Indian Icon of the Year award at the annual UK-India Awards in June 2023

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mary Kom **has had an incredible **20-year journey**, dedicating her life to boxing and making sacrifices for her country and family.
 
• The award recognizes her outstanding contributions to sports and her impact on strengthening b**ilateral ties between the UK and India**
 
• The UK-India Awards, now in their **fifth year, celebrate **the achievements of leaders in business, professional services, government, culture, and social impact
 
• Mary Kom** received the award at a gala ceremony** held at Fairmont Windsor Park on June 29, 2023
 
• Indian High Commissioner to the UK, **Vikram Doraiswami, presented the award to her** .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mary Kom**

 
 
• She is the **First Indian woman to win an Olympic medal **in boxing (2012 London Olympics)
 
• She's a **six-time World Amateur Boxing Champion**, winning titles in 2002, 2005, 2006, 2008, 2010, and 2018
 
• Mary Kom r**eceived India's second-highest civilian honour**, the Padma Vibhushan, in 2020
 
• In 2016, **she was nominated to the Upper House of Parliament**, becoming a member of the Rajya Sabha ¹[3).
